accounting_policy.baseline: actual per-task direct Codex CLI turn.completed telemetry
accounting_policy.triage: actual one-call Codex CLI triage over all 50 task contracts; its full cost is conservatively allocated across the 45 eligible tasks
accounting_policy.delegation: zero separately priced frontier tokens because the triage call directly owned the task contracts; local Qwen generation is not Codex usage
accounting_policy.review: actual one-call Codex CLI batch review over all 45 eligible candidates, allocated by evidence-packet size
accounting_policy.repair: actual one-call Codex CLI repair for exact-logging after review rejection
accounting_policy.local_model_tokens: recorded separately and excluded from Codex savings
accounting_policy.blocked_tasks: their triage cost is conservatively included in the eligible-task triage allocation
accounting_policy.delegation_seconds: zero: the runner already includes each delegated record duration; local runtime seconds remain recorded separately
